path_between.max_hops=2: MATCH path = shortestPath((a:WikiPage {slug:$slug_a})-[:SUPPORTS|CONFLICTS_WITH|BACKLINK|DERIVED_FROM|EXTRACTED_FROM*..2]-(b:WikiPage {slug:$slug_b})) RETURN path LIMIT $limit
path_between.max_hops=3: MATCH path = shortestPath((a:WikiPage {slug:$slug_a})-[:SUPPORTS|CONFLICTS_WITH|BACKLINK|DERIVED_FROM|EXTRACTED_FROM*..3]-(b:WikiPage {slug:$slug_b})) RETURN path LIMIT $limit
path_between.max_hops=4: MATCH path = shortestPath((a:WikiPage {slug:$slug_a})-[:SUPPORTS|CONFLICTS_WITH|BACKLINK|DERIVED_FROM|EXTRACTED_FROM*..4]-(b:WikiPage {slug:$slug_b})) RETURN path LIMIT $limit

conflicts_of.default: MATCH (c:WikiClaim {slug:$slug})-[k:CONFLICTS_WITH]-(o) RETURN c, k, o LIMIT $limit

page_conflicts.default: MATCH (p:WikiPage {slug:$slug}) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[bl:BACKLINK]-(c:WikiClaim)-[k:CONFLICTS_WITH]-(o) RETURN p, bl, c, k, o LIMIT $limit

provenance_chain.default: MATCH (c:WikiClaim {slug:$slug})-[sr:SUPPORTS]->(s:WikiSource)-[er:EXTRACTED_FROM]->(d:Document) RETURN c, sr, s, er, d LIMIT $limit

entity_mentions.default: MATCH (e:Entity {name_norm:$name_norm})-[m:MENTIONED_IN]->(n) RETURN e, m, n LIMIT $limit
